'''Tabiid''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tabiid system/Legends|Tabiid system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that served as a base for the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
